scheme_name: Jharkhand State Backward Classes Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a native of Jharkhand.
Must belong to the Other Backward Class (OBC) category.
Family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.
Must be enrolled in a recognized educational institution registered on the departmental scholarship portal.
Must be pursuing a post‑matriculation course (degree, diploma, certificate, or equivalent).
Must not be receiving any other scholarship or financial assistance from the central or state government.
Must adhere to the attendance system prescribed by the institution/university.
If switching courses mid‑year, eligibility for the new course applies only if no scholarship was received for the previous course in the same academic year.
benefits_summary: Provides tuition fee, academic allowance, and maintenance support up to ₹1,00,000 for hostellers and ₹90,000 for day‑scholars, credited directly to the Aadhaar‑linked bank account.
